# keyfactor_certificate_collection (Resource)

Manages a Keyfactor Command certificate collection.

## Known Limitations

**The `query` attribute is not returned by the Keyfactor Command API on read.** The `GET /CertificateCollections/{id}` and `GET /CertificateCollections` endpoints do not include `Query` in their response. Only the `POST` (create) and `PUT` (update) responses return it.

The provider works around this by preserving the `query` value from Terraform state on refresh. This means:

- Changes to `query` made through Terraform (`terraform apply`) work correctly and round-trip cleanly.
- The computed `content` attribute always reflects the server-side query expression and updates on every refresh.
- **Changes to the query made outside of Terraform** (e.g. directly in the Command UI) **will not be detected** by `terraform plan`. The `content` attribute will update to reflect the new server-side expression, but `query` in state will remain stale. To re-sync, remove the resource from state (`terraform state rm`) and re-import it.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the certificate collection.
- `query` (String) The query expression that defines which certificates belong to this collection. This attribute must always be declared and must never be removed from configuration once set. Not returned by the server on read (a Keyfactor Command API limitation); the provider preserves the last-known value from state instead. Use `content` to see the server-normalized form. Changes to `query` made outside of Terraform (e.g. in the Command UI) will not be detected by the provider. Note: a certificate collection can only be imported and managed by Terraform if it has a non-empty query.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the certificate collection.
- `duplication_field` (Number) Determines how duplicate certificate subjects are identified. 0=None, 1=CommonName, 2=DistinguishedName, 3=PrincipalName.
- `favorite` (Boolean) Whether this collection is marked as a favorite.
- `show_on_dashboard` (Boolean) Whether to show this collection on the Keyfactor Command dashboard.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The server-normalized form of the collection query.
- `estimated_cert_count` (Number) The estimated number of certificates matching this collection's query.
- `id` (Number) The server-assigned ID of the certificate collection.
- `last_estimated` (String) Timestamp of when the estimated certificate count was last calculated.
